pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit highly irregular, jagged boundaries with sharp pixel-level gradients. The geometry is dendritic or star-like, particularly on the mid-neck and upper shoulder. Patch area decreases and shape becomes more globular toward the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, multi-nodal graph. Junctions are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, exhibiting greater pixel-width on the mid-flank compared to the narrow, dense channels visible on the lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette of the mane along the upper neck displays a consistent, high-frequency serrated profile with low amplitude against the blurred background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural discontinuity is visible in the mane profile at the transition point between the lower neck and the shoulder ridge where the hair line thins.
